ocl:
context Cluster
inv: (self.gateways->exists(x | x.isPrimary = true)) and (self.name <> '' and self.name.size() > 0)

context AlertRule
inv: (self.alerts->exists(x | x.acknowledged = true)) and (self.alerts->size() <= 1)

context DataStream
inv: self.alertRules->any(x | x.ruleId <> '') <> null

context DataStream
inv: self.records->any(x | x.timestamp <> '') <> null

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 17 and self.maxLoad <= 83

context Battery
inv: self.healthPct >= 46 and self.healthPct <= 55

context APIKey
inv: (self.createdAt <> null) and (self.user <> null)

context ConnectivityModule
inv: (self.links->any(x | x.bandwidthKbps > 1) <> null) and (self.links->notEmpty())

context AccessPolicy
inv: ((self.description <> '') and (self.roles->forAll(v | v.roleName <> ''))) and (not((self.description <> '') and (self.roles->forAll(v | v.roleName <> ''))))

context SensorNode
inv: (self.sampleRateHz mod 2 = 1) and (not(self.sampleRateHz mod 2 = 1))

context DataStream
inv: ((self.link.isSecure) and (self.topic.size() >= 19)) and (not((self.link.isSecure) and (self.topic.size() >= 19)))

context CommunicationLink
inv: (self.bandwidthKbps >= 48 and self.bandwidthKbps <= 66) and (self.bandwidthKbps < 48)

context APIKey
inv: (self.user <> null) and (not(self.user <> null))

context IoTPlatform
inv: (self.networks->forAll(x | x.networkId <> '')) and (not(self.networks->forAll(x | x.networkId <> '')))

context AccessPolicy
inv: (self.platform <> null) and (not(self.platform <> null))

context AccessPolicy
inv: ((self.rulesJson <> '') and (self.roles->forAll(v | v.roleName <> ''))) and (not((self.rulesJson <> '') and (self.roles->forAll(v | v.roleName <> ''))))
